3122bcd694a27581.text:
Q: How do I return a product?
A: To return a product, please follow these steps: 1) Log into your account on our website, 2) Go to 'My Orders' and select the order containing the item, 3) Click 'Request Return' and follow the prompts, 4) Print the prepaid shipping label, 5) Pack the item securely and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Returns must be initiated within 30 days of delivery.

metadata.title: How do I return a product?

749a17915b465d9b.text:
Q: What is your refund policy?
A: Once we receive your return, we will inspect the item and process your refund within 5-7 business days. Refunds are credited to your original payment method. For credit card payments, it may take an additional 3-5 business days to appear on your statement. If you paid with store credit, your refund will be issued as store credit.

7afed55567b7d01a.text:
Q: How long does shipping take?
A: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping takes 2-3 business days. Same-day delivery is available in select metropolitan areas for orders placed before 12 PM. All orders are processed within 1-2 business days before shipping. You will receive a tracking number via email once your order ships.

28c68edfd1c072af.text:
Q: Do you offer international shipping?
A: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping typically takes 7-14 business days depending on the destination. Please note that international orders may be subject to customs duties and taxes, which are the responsibility of the customer. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location.

f12a8b6f0e4ff224.text:
Q: How do I track my order?
A: You can track your order by: 1) Logging into your account and viewing 'My Orders', 2) Clicking the tracking number in your shipping confirmation email, 3) Using our 'Track Order' page with your order number and email. Tracking information is usually available within 24 hours of shipping.

metadata.title: How do I track my order?

a254a50977cc8165.text:
Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and store gift cards. For orders over $200, we also offer PayPal Pay in 4 and Klarna for installment payments. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

metadata.title: What payment methods do you accept?

f891c6ec7d805d1f.text:
Q: How do I cancel my order?
A: To cancel your order, please contact us within 1 hour of placing it. Once an order starts processing, it cannot be canceled. You can reach our customer service team via chat on our website, by calling 1-800-SUPPORT, or by emailing support@example.com. If your order has already shipped, you can refuse delivery or initiate a return.

metadata.title: How do I cancel my order?

446e298b9de0735f.text:
Q: How do I contact customer support?
A: You can reach our customer support team through multiple channels: 1) Live chat on our website (available 24/7), 2) Phone at 1-800-SUPPORT (Mon-Fri 8am-8pm EST), 3) Email at support@example.com (response within 24 hours), 4) Social media @OurCompany on Twitter and Facebook. For urgent issues, live chat provides the fastest response.

metadata.title: How do I contact customer support?

277e8f34a51c79ad.text:
Q: Do you have a loyalty program?
A: Yes! Our Rewards Program lets you earn points on every purchase. Earn 1 point per dollar spent. 100 points = $5 reward. Members also get exclusive access to sales, birthday discounts, and free shipping on orders over $50. Sign up for free on our website or download our mobile app.

metadata.title: Do you have a loyalty program?

af45e7e837e9e3cd.text:
Q: What is your warranty policy?
A: All products come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. Extended warranty plans are available for purchase. Warranty claims require proof of purchase. For warranty service, contact support with your order number and a description of the issue. We will arrange repair, replacement, or refund as appropriate.

f32c4f4c8676b05d.text:
Return Policy
Our return policy allows customers to return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by the original receipt or order confirmation. Certain items are excluded from returns including: personalized items, final sale items, intimate apparel, and hazardous materials. To initiate a return, log into your account or contact customer service. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days of receiving the return.

743abd066be74c3a.text:
Shipping Policy
We offer multiple shipping options to meet your needs. Standard Shipping (5-7 business days): Free on orders over $50, $5.99 otherwise. Express Shipping (2-3 business days): $12.99. Same-Day Delivery: $19.99 in select areas. Orders placed before 2 PM EST ship the same day. Orders ship from our warehouses Monday through Friday. We ship to all 50 US states and over 50 countries internationally. Tracking information is provided for all orders.

de756147a8c5366d.text:
Privacy Policy Summary
We collect information you provide directly, such as account details and payment information. We also collect browsing data to improve your experience. Your data is never sold to third parties. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your information. You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting privacy@example.com. We retain data for up to 7 years for compliance purposes. For full details, visit our Privacy Center.

1d2567d801099840.text:
Price Match Guarantee
We offer a price match guarantee. If you find a lower price on an identical item from an authorized retailer within 14 days of purchase, we will match it. To request a price match, contact customer service with the competitor's current advertised price, including the URL or advertisement. Excludes membership pricing, coupon codes, promotional offers, and marketplace sellers. Limit one price match per item per customer.

fb4115c3c5a68e9a.text:
Order Cancellation Policy
Orders may be cancelled within 1 hour of placement if they haven't entered processing. To cancel, log into your account or contact customer service immediately. Orders that have started processing or shipped cannot be cancelled but can be returned after delivery. Subscription orders must be cancelled 48 hours before the next shipment date. Cancelled orders are refunded within 3-5 business days.

ec9338e5287dbd2a.text:
Exchange Policy
We offer free exchanges within 30 days of delivery. To exchange an item, initiate an exchange request through your account or contact customer service. Select your replacement item and we will ship it as soon as we receive your return. If the replacement item costs more, you will be charged the difference. If it costs less, we will refund the difference. Exchanges for the same item in a different size or color ship with expedited shipping at no extra cost.
